newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends barely down in dull dealings.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends barely down in dull dealings.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures ended barely weaker after a late-session bout of commission house selling knocked prices below unchanged, dealers said.

Refiner pricing on a scale-down basis kept prices steady for most of the day, but speculative selling in the May/July spread and commission house selling in the May contract put pressure on the market.
"It's time to roll," a trader said. "People are getting the inclination to move positions before the crowd comes in."
He expects further liquidation on Tuesday, April 1. The last trading day for benchmark May is April 30.
LIFFE, closed for the Easter holiday, kept activity light, dealers said. But trade could remain rangebound and thin amid a dearth of fundamental news and a neutral technical outlook.
Volume was estimated at only 6,689 lots compared to Thursday's official 9,671 lots.
May closed 0.02 cent weaker at 10.79 cents per lb, having ranged from 10.87 to 10.78. The deferred contracts settled 0.02 and 0.01 weaker.
Support remained at 10.68 cents basis May and resistance at 11.09 cents.
Open interest in most-active May fell 1,259 lots to 58,654 lots as of Thursday's close.
